sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Sharon, 'TOWN OF SHARON VERMONT 2026 RESULTS' sheet, attested by Town Clerk Catherine Sartor, March 3, 2026 (160 Australian-ballot voters; 100 at the floor meeting): Stephen Basham was elected Town Moderator. The 2025 report's meeting guide records that no nominating petitions were filed for the office; Basham is the incumbent moderator, named as the winner in the town's own attested results, and is recorded as elected on that certified outcome (disclosed on issue #163)

jp_election.name: Town of Sharon Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names five winners for Sharon's five justice of the peace seats. Only four of the five serve: the 2025 town report's elected list shows Barrett, Fullerton, Gray, and Jones, with Sherri Lorette seated by state appointment to fill a vacancy -- Lisa Flanders, the fifth name in the listing, appears nowhere in the town's records and is excluded entirely under the departed-winner pattern, her story told here. The town voted in March 2025 to increase its justices to seven, effective for the next cycle

Town of Sharon, 2025 Town Report, 'Town of Sharon 2025 Elected Officials' and '2025 Appointed Officials' lists (report pp. 14-15): the Justices of the Peace list names Helen Barrett, Victoria Fullerton, Chelsea Gray, and Suzanne Jones from the November 2024 general election, plus Sherri Lorette by state appointment to fill a vacancy
